channel.title: BULWARK — Changelog
channel.description: Public changelog for BULWARK, the autonomous external pentest agent. Releases, fixes, security advisories.

item.title: v5.32 — STIX 2.1 export for SIEM ingest
item.description: Findings now drop into Splunk, Elastic, Sentinel without custom glue. STIX 2.1 bundles emitted per engagement, with TLP:AMBER default and optional TLP:GREEN for public reports.
item.content:encoded: Findings now drop into Splunk, Elastic, Sentinel without custom glue. STIX 2.1 bundles emitted per engagement, with TLP:AMBER default and optional TLP:GREEN for public reports.

item.title: v5.31 — Faster CVE matching
item.description: CVE matching refreshed daily instead of weekly — 18% faster time-to-detect on emerging CVEs.

item.title: v5.30 — Air-gap approved payload set
item.description: Air-gap approved payload set for Enterprise deployments — runs without internet egress.

item.title: v5.29.1 — CDN wildcard fix
item.description: Out-of-scope host detection no longer false-positives on CDNs with wildcard DNS records.

item.title: v5.29 — Close-the-loop workflow
item.description: Close-the-loop workflow — BULWARK opens a PR with the fix and auto-verifies on your staging.
